name: al-madinah-college
description: Al-Madinah International College — public site. Static, no framework: scripts/build-madinah.js assembles madinah-src/ into the English and Arabic trees, and the output is committed.
comment_on_modules: No root-level "type" field. scripts/build-madinah.js is CommonJS; Node 22 auto-detects, so nothing needs declaring. Do not add "type": "module" without converting the generator first.
